answer: Novartis reported reaching 304 million patients and selling products in 118 countries in 2025. Patients reached covers the global registered and commercialized portfolio, including established medicines, third-party sales, patient support programs, donations and access foundations, but excludes samples, certain contract brands and certain radioligand therapy brands; it uses therapy volumes plus dosage, treatment-duration and compliance assumptions and may double-count a person treated for different diseases with more than one Novartis product. Countries require third-party sales above USD 1 million and ongoing operations, are cross-checked to UN geography, and exclude some overseas departments or districts/regions.
